positive_snippets: Great place to stay, very comfortable, neat & clean. But one problem was with the geyser, so there is no separate geysers for rooms. There is some common geyser that connects to all rooms . And you don’t get hot water as expected in winters . Majority time it was hardly Luke warm. Also that warm water timing is from 6am to 9am then from 6pm to 9pm . So apart from these timings you don’t get even the warm water , it will be cold . So I would say it’s a great place to stay in summers and rainy season , avoid during winters. Also The towels offered seemed little old with all the linen coming out & sticking on to your skin all the time . Otherwise There is mini fridge , kettle. Excellent room service . Good food. Very good manager.

I had a wonderful stay at Hotel Sunstart Height. The staff here are extremely polite and helpful, always ready with a smile and great service. Their behavior made me feel very comfortable and welcomed throughout my stay. Truly a great experience, and I would definitely recommend this hotel to others.

I recently stayed at Hotel Sunstar Heights and it was a wonderful experience. Mr. Nair and the staff was warm, welcoming, and always ready to assist with a smile. The check-in process was smooth and efficient.

I had a very pleasant stay and would highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for comfort, good service, and value for money. I would definitely choose to stay here again.
